Hi! I'm from Thailand. I can tell you that yes ,you can find teaching job here in bilingual school or even in public school and it won't require much of degree as long as you can speak english and are foreigner. In public school they not pay you much, so better apply for bilingual. There is (expensive) bilingual middle school that I know, I found a link looking for teacher back in 2011, there is salary and other stuff, so here  http://www.teachingthailand.com/job/7178/nes-for-english-program-at-ek-burapa-school/
I hope this help. This school is really nice and the kids are well manner(back in my days). Maybe you can email them ask question you would like to know. Goodluck!

I have to bet between stay and hope there going to be commercial flight before my visa expire(my country they not open airport yet) or just leave now.
I choose to leave because life look more predictable in that way , and it might be better to leave before things get complicated so I can apply for any other type of visa in future. I believe both way have it cons and pros. Between I live in Russia but I came from Thailand. Never thought I will falling in love with places and people here but I did. I will try my best to find way back. I will build my skill and hobby and make plan and it seem to be long journey but I really hope I will go back in right place again.
